thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager -> oncall (sev=P1)

Sam Nguyen (oncall): getting repeated pod evictions on prod-model-serving after a traffic spike. Kubelet showing DiskPressure and pods evicted for ephemeral-storage. Rescheduled pods sometimes crash with CUDA init/illegal memory access. Tagging eng-runtime + infra.

Anya Shah: can you paste the node names and the biggest dirs?

Sam Nguyen (oncall): nodes: gke-prod-rt-05 and gke-prod-rt-09. quick du of kubelet volumes returned multiple model-cache directories at 7-14GB each.

Leo Martinez: that matches a recent regression where the runtime writes per-request quantized cache into the pod filesystem without a cap. Is this the quantize-on-write flow?

Sam Nguyen (oncall): looks like it. snippets:

```
$ kubectl describe pod model-serve-9c7d -n prod
Events:
  Type    Reason    Age   From               Message
  ----    ------    ----  ----               -------
  Warning Evicted   12m   kubelet, node-rt-05 The node had condition: DiskPressure
  Normal  Killing   12m   kubelet, node-rt-05 Stopping container model-server
```

```
$ kubectl logs model-serve-9c7d -n prod -c model-server --previous
2026-10-03T03:22:11Z [err] cuda: initialization failed (out of memory) when allocating 256MB
2026-10-03T03:22:14Z [info] restarting process
```

```
$ sudo du -sh /var/lib/kubelet/pods/*/volumes/*/model-cache | sort -h | tail -n 15
2.1G  /var/lib/kubelet/pods/aaaa-.../model-cache
8.6G  /var/lib/kubelet/pods/bbbb-.../model-cache
13G   /var/lib/kubelet/pods/cccc-.../model-cache
```

Kai Chen: sounds like multiple large cache dirs on the nodes pushed usage past kubelet's eviction threshold. Once eviction happens, some GPU processes may be left with corrupted CUDA contexts and subsequent starts hit init errors.

Maya Patel: customer-facing impact? any elevated 5xx or timeouts?

Sam Nguyen (oncall): yes — generation endpoints showing ~5% 5xx for ~15 minutes. A handful of enterprise customers filed support tickets. Dispatching to SRE and support.

Anya Shah: immediate mitigation plan (short):
1) Free disk on the impacted nodes by removing stale model-cache for terminated pods only.
2) Cordon and drain affected nodes to prevent further scheduling and to let us reprovision safely.
3) Force-kill stray GPU processes on nodes if CUDA init errors persist after reschedule.
4) Apply a hotfix to runtime to cap per-process cache and enable cache TTL/GC.

Sam Nguyen (oncall): started step 1. Running a conservative cleanup to only touch files older than 15m and owned by absent pod UIDs.

```
# remove cache files for pod dirs that are not active
for d in /var/lib/kubelet/pods/*; do
  if [ ! -d "$d/..data" ]; then
    find "$d" -type f -path "*/model-cache/*" -mmin +15 -delete
  fi
done
```

Leo Martinez: I'll cordon/drain once you confirm disk freed. Also prepare a safe kubelet restart plan if needed.

Sam Nguyen (oncall): cleaned ~16GB on node-rt-05 and ~9GB on node-rt-09. Evictions stopped and some pods rescheduled. Running health checks now.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by Sam Nguyen at 2026-10-03T03:27:20Z

Kai Chen: to reduce recurrence, we can flip runtime to use lazy-fetch + on-disk cap: set MODEL_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=2500000000 and MODEL_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=900. Also optionally point cache to /tmp and mount tmpfs for select node pools, but that risks losing cache on node restart.

Anya Shah: started cordon + drain on node-rt-05. Will coordinate with Leo for node-rt-09.

Maya Patel: I'm creating an incident channel and looping in Support to notify impacted customers. Will draft a short status update (what happened, affected endpoints, mitigation in progress).

Sam Nguyen (oncall): note: after a few reschedules we still saw pods in CrashLoopBackOff with CUDA errors. Collected a stack:

```
RuntimeError: cuda runtime error (700) : an illegal memory access was encountered at /opt/torch/…
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 210, in <module>
    runner.setup_cuda()
  File "engine/gpu.py", line 88, in setup_cuda
    torch.cuda.set_device(0)
RuntimeError: CUDA error: initialization error
```

Leo Martinez: that points to GPU driver/daemon state left dirty after abrupt eviction. On affected nodes, sudo pkill -9 of orphaned processes using NVIDIA devices and restart nvidia-modprobe/kubelet tends to clear the condition. Doing that carefully.

Kai Chen: rolling a small config override to pods in prod namespace to set --cache-max-bytes=2500000000 for the next replicas. I'll prepare a canary (5% pods) with the env change before full roll. Also opening a hotfix PR to add proactive GC in the runtime.

Sam Nguyen (oncall): executed pkill on node-rt-05, restarted kubelet service; new pods coming up without CUDA init errors so far. Monitoring.

Maya Patel: handoff for night shift (to Anya):
- probable root cause: unbounded model-cache growth during a request surge produced ephemeral-storage pressure -> kubelet evicted pods -> some restarts suffered CUDA init failures due to GPU state corruption.
- customer impact: ~5% 5xx on gen APIs for ~10-20m; several enterprise customers hit; support notified.
- mitigations applied: cleaned stale cache files (~25GB total freed across nodes), cordoned/drained nodes, killed stale GPU processes, kubelet restart where necessary, temporary pod env override to cap cache size, support will send customer updates.
- follow-ups: implement runtime-enforced cache cap + TTL, add node alert for ephemeral-storage threshold earlier, consider moving cache to a bounded PV or tmpfs for model-serving nodepools, postmortem and regression test for quantize-on-write.

Anya Shah: taking over incident lead. I'll keep the channel open and run a full cluster sweep for other nodes with >70% disk usage under /var/lib/kubelet. Also will validate the hotfix PR and coordinate the canary.

k8s-scheduler: Node gke-prod-rt-05 cordoned by Anya Shah at 2026-10-03T03:33:12Z

incident-bot: Severity: P1. Incident remains P1 until service health is stable for 30m post-mitigation.

Maya Patel: adding a quick customer-facing blurb to the incident channel for support to copy. If anyone has leftover node du outputs or system journal snippets, DM me.

Kai Chen: PR opened: add MODEL_CACHE_MAX_BYTES, MODEL_CACHE_TTL, and periodic GC job. Target: hotfix branch -> canary -> full rollout.

Sam Nguyen (oncall): leaving notes in incident doc and handing to Anya. Good job team. :thumbsup:

Anya Shah: acknowledged, taking over. Will publish timeline and assign RCA author.

--- end thread ---
